children: Ahead of the upcoming Medicare Open Enrollment period, health insurers highlighted their Medicare Advantage plans on Thursday, with Humana
, the second-largest MA insurer, indicating a sharp reduction in its market footprint.

In a statement on Thursday, the Louisville, Kentucky-based firm announced that its MA plans will be available in nearly 2,600 counties across 45 states and Washington, D.C., representing more than 80%
For the 2026 plan year, Humana
, whose MA operations trail only those of UnitedHealth
, offered MA plans across 46 states and Washington, D.C., covering
The MA market is grappling with rising medical costs and intense government scrutiny, forcing health insurers to scale back their offerings.
Earlier this week, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services said that 2027 MA enrollments are expected to reach 34M, a 6% decline, despite over a 16% decline in MA premiums
on a weighted average basis.
UnitedHealth

, the largest MA player, repeatedly issued below-consensus earnings guidance last year, citing elevated medical expenses. The Eden Prairie, Minnesota-based healthcare giant on Thursday said that its UnitedHealthcare MA plans will be accessible to 94% of Medicare-eligible individuals next year, unchanged from 2026.
However, citing a company spokesperson, Bloomberg reported that roughly 390,000 people will be part of UnitedHealth
plans that are shutting down. Humana
has announced its intention to discontinue plans affecting 600,000 enrollees.
CVS Health’s
Aetna unit and Centene
are also pulling back their MA offerings, according to CMS data reviewed by Wall Street analysts this week.
However, Alignment Healthcare
, which heavily relies on MA plans, is expanding.

Announcing its MA portfolio for 2027, the company said on Thursday that its geographic footprint will increase to 55 counties next year, adding more than 934,000 Medicare-eligible seniors across ten new counties. Alignment
seeks to offer 77 MA plans across Arizona, California, Nevada, North Carolina, and Texas, catering to nearly 9.5M Medicare-eligible seniors.
Clover Health
said that its MA plans will be available to 5.2M Medicare-eligible individuals within 203 counties across five states.
The next Medicare Open Enrollment period runs from Oct. 15 to Dec. 7, giving Americans aged 65 and older and those with disabilities the option to compare and select 2027 MA plans.

title: Humana shrinks Medicare Advantage footprint
